why: stop_hook_active means the gate already blocked this turn; blocking again is an infinite loop, and Claude Code's own contract forbids it
the gate is scoped to uncommitted TS under apps/, libs/ and e2e/ — with nothing changed there is nothing to run, and a clean tree must not cost a vitest boot
the loop-protection branch keys off stop_hook_active in the payload; a truncated payload used to miss it and exit 0, which is the same answer the gate gives when everything is green
